details: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index, rose 4.1% year-over-year in May 2026, marking its steepest climb since April 2023. Core PCE, excluding volatile food and energy, also increased to 3.4% annually, the highest since October 2023, both remaining significantly above the Fed's 2% target. This persistent inflation reinforces expectations for the Federal Reserve to maintain a hawkish monetary policy, potentially keeping interest rates higher for longer or even considering further hikes, which generally pressures risk assets like cryptocurrencies. This outlook, combined with ongoing Bitcoin ETF outflows, continues to weigh on investor sentiment, with Bitcoin struggling around the $60,000 mark.
title: US Inflation Surges, Bolstering Fed's Hawkish Stance on Rates

details: The Central Bank of Brazil has proposed a new measure that would implement a mandatory 24-hour hold for cross-border remittances and payments sent using stablecoins, particularly for transactions exceeding $10,000. This proposed holding period aims to allow virtual asset service providers (VASPs) to conduct due diligence and screen transactions for legitimacy and risk assessment. While funds could be released sooner if risks are mitigated, this new rule could introduce friction and potentially hinder the efficiency and adoption of stablecoins for large business-to-business (B2B) transactions and institutional use in Brazil.
title: Brazil Proposes 24-Hour Hold on Large Stablecoin Transactions
